verifiedButtonLegacyContext.scope: context only; not a per-cell blind grade

variant.primary: omit variant attribute (the package's actual primary default)

state.focus-visible: sentinel focus followed by keyboard Tab

sourceApiMap.recipeSize: medium is fixed on recipe/legacy only; source has no size API
sourceApiMap.icons: none; source Button exposes no icon slot
sourceApiMap.label: light-DOM text child

capabilityCoverageOutsidePairedMatrix: isDisabled sets aria-disabled but shipped :disabled styling is unreachable
mappingDecisions: The absent variant is primary; danger is not relabelled as primary.
Secondary maps directly to the source variant of the same meaning.
Only browser-stimulated hover and focus-visible join the paired matrix.
Unsupported source size/icon/loading/disabled cells are excluded by name.

state.focus-visible: sentinel focus followed by keyboard Tab

sourceApiMap.recipeSize: source size="medium"; shared matrix excludes size because Altitude has no size API
sourceApiMap.icons: none; the optional Fluent icon slot is intentionally empty
sourceApiMap.label: React children

mappingDecisions: Primary and secondary map directly to Fluent appearance values.
Size is pinned to medium for the shared denominator.
Shape is pinned to rounded and iconPosition to before.
Only browser-stimulated hover and focus-visible join the paired matrix.

protocol.passThreshold: independent recognisable=true for each paired specimen

legacy.reflow: contract HTML uses real flex/inline-flex layout; no fixed coordinates in the sampled Button roots
legacy.variantSwitching: legacy contract axes map to source variants in the frozen matrix
legacy.tokenBinding: legacy HTML resolves committed bundle tokenSet custom properties

recipe.reflow: recipe React/WC outputs use inline-flex and content padding
recipe.variantSwitching: data-variant and data-state select explicit recipe cells
recipe.tokenBinding: every emitted var() reference has a generated custom-property definition
recipe.noFakeLayout: button@1 IR and emitted code use auto/flex layout, not coordinates
